notes.title: HALF PRICE for LudoNarraCon 2022
notes.content:
Half the price? That's double the value!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/c14a6c9bff32414021e0998f3d4dddd58f128060.png

To celebrate our participation in LudoNarraCon 2022, anyone who buys Negative Nancy during the festival will only pay half the normal price!

But once you've finished Negative Nancy, what will you play? What about one of these juicy demos? Or one of the 140+ narrative games discounted? You're kind of spoiled for choice.

As Boss would say, you miss shots when you don't take them, 100% of the time!

Love,
The Negative Nancy team

notes.title: Negative Nancy is available NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=RAd5siQ5GWo;full][/previewyoutube]

Negative Nancy, our 'choose your no adventure' game is now available!

The episodes you unlock by playing the game are filled with secrets, side-paths, alternative endings and bizarre situations. Play for a second or third time and you might experience a very different story!

Each episode played on normal speed lasts for roughly 20 to 30 minutes depending on path taken, so you can play it in bite sized pieces or just binge the whole thing.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851976/ed99a165b22cfdbd480f3e192ab38f95755483e4.png


We're a small team, and we're thrilled to finally release Negative Nancy into the world like tearful parents sending a small, disagreeable child to their first day at school.

If you want to talk more about Nancy, or you're just tired of screaming into the void you can join our discord!

https://discord.gg/RQW8SWZ 

Happy Naysaying!

- The team at FEED

notes.title: PRANK PUSHER 192 HOUR NEXT FEST BONANZA
notes.content:
Prank Pusher, world's richest StreamTuber is back for another epic STEAM FESTIVAL LIVE STREAM BONANZA!

To celebrate his starring role in upcoming title Negative Nancy, Prank Pusher has agreed to "donate" 192 hours of his time to live streaming our new demo, making sure you get the most expensive Negative Nancy coverage that money can buy.

Get ready for 8 straight sleepless days of Prank Pusher. No sleep til Nancy!

Prank Pusher

The world's second most popular StreamTuber, Prank Pusher rose to prominence when his video ‘Baby gets WRECKED candy prank GONE WRONG!!!’ went viral, amassing him a legion of adoring fans.

His loyal millions-strong #AddictArmy are extremely vocal in their support of their idol, and despise his perceived enemies.

He enters MegaMart to prank the staff for his latest live stream, but will his prank-themed content go off script when he comes face to face with a retail worker named Nancy?

Wishlist, follow and subscribe for more Prank Pusher vs. Nancy content!
